blocks.text: BATAC CITY, ILOCOS NORTE, Philippines — Holding placards and raising calls for the protection of land, life, and national sovereignty, youth-led progressive groups, students, and church leaders staged protests in Northern Luzon on Monday, Nov. 16, against the Pax Silica initiative and what they described as environmental plunder. In Batac City, protesters marched near the Marcos Museum, urging the youth to stand with Indigenous peoples, farmers, fisherfolk, and other marginalized communities. They also demanded a halt to the proposed offshore wind farm project and what they described as destructive solar farm developments.
